groups.defect: The getForLogin login cache (cacheKeyForLogin) is only invalidated by IdentityProviderStorageProvider create/update/remove. Linking or unlinking an IdP through OrganizationProvider.addIdentityProvider/removeIdentityProvider changes the result of the login predicate, but nothing invalidates the cache, so stale IdentityProviderListQuery entries are left behind.

answer.reasoning: Both suggestions report the same defect. When an IdP is linked to or unlinked from an organization through InfinispanOrganizationProvider, the login cache is not invalidated. Both propose the same fix: invalidate cacheKeyForLogin for all FetchModes in that provider. s_c0312a1d also mentions the organization-enabled toggle, but only inside its proposed fix and not as a separately reported defect. So it does not add a second defect, and one comment from either suggestion covers the issue. They are in the same file but anchor on different, non-adjacent code: getForLogin at lines 213-255 and the invalidation helpers at lines 382-418. Because of that I chose cross_location, though same_location would also be defensible. The kind choice is a judgment call, but the grouping itself is clear.
